title: Elevator Services
agency: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.US COAST GUARD.BASE CAPE COD(00052)
description_text: Base cape Cod requires inspection and maintenance of its on base elevators for Base plus 4 option as per the attached SOW. For site visits please contact Jim Pulsifer at 571-607-4150 Quotes must be submitted on company letterhead. Quotes must be broken down by base year and each option year: Base Year: 01 June 2026 – 31 May 2027 Option Year 1: 01 June 2027 – 31 May 2028 Option Year 2: 01 June 2028 – 31 May 2029 Option Year 3: 01 June 2029 – 31 May 2030 Option Year 4: 01 June 2030 – 31 May 2031
